title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Maryland-College Park
description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with published late availability in and around College Park.

cards.title: College Park Diner
cards.subtitle: 9206 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Use the diner when you need a sit-down meal late in the evening; its official site lists daily service from 6 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A diner with daily service extending to 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: College Park Diner publishes hours of 6 a.m.–2 a.m. every day at its Baltimore Avenue location.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists the restaurant open every day, 6 a.m.–2 a.m.; confirm before traveling because schedules can change.

cards.title: Dog Haus Biergarten College Park
cards.subtitle: 7401 Baltimore Ave, Suite 1A, College Park
cards.notes: Plan a food-focused stop on Baltimore Avenue; the City’s business listing shows 1 a.m. closing on select days and 2 a.m. on Wed–Sat.
cards.short_summary: Baltimore Avenue food counter with published late closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of College Park lists Dog Haus Biergarten hours through 2 a.m. Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: City of College Park — ITGA 2024 participating businesses
cards.access_notes: City listing gives 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Wed–Sat and 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Sun–Tue; verify on the day of your visit.

cards.title: Raising Cane's Baltimore Ave
cards.subtitle: 7400 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Choose pickup, dine-in, or drive-thru at this College Park location when the evening runs long; published closing reaches 2 a.m. Thu–Sat.
cards.short_summary: Chicken-finger restaurant open as late as 2 a.m. on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its 7400 Baltimore Ave location open until 2 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's — Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 1 a.m. Sun–Wed and 2 a.m. Thu–Sat; dine-in and drive-thru availability may differ.

cards.title: Shake Shack College Park
cards.subtitle: 4394 Knox Rd, College Park
cards.notes: Head to Knox Road for burgers, chicken, hot dogs, or frozen custard; the location page posts midnight closes most weekdays and 1 a.m. weekends.
cards.short_summary: Knox Road counter service with midnight-or-later hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack’s College Park page lists closing at midnight Monday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists midnight closes Mon–Thu and 1 a.m. Fri–Sun. Check the page for holiday or event changes.

cards.title: Taco Bell Baltimore Avenue
cards.subtitle: 8428 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late food run on Baltimore Avenue; published drive-thru hours extend beyond the dining room’s stated closing time.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru option with service as late as 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Sunday at 8428 Baltimore Ave.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 8428 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 2–3 a.m.; its dine-in hours end earlier, so use the drive-thru schedule for late visits.

cards.title: Marathon Deli
cards.subtitle: 7412 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s ordering page for a pickup window after midnight; it posts online ordering from 12 a.m. through 2:40 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Baltimore Avenue deli with a published after-midnight ordering window.
cards.evidence_claim: Marathon Deli’s ordering page lists online ordering hours of 12 a.m.–2:40 a.m. and 10 a.m.–10:40 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The official ordering page shows a midnight–2:40 a.m. online-ordering window; check pickup availability and timing before leaving.

cards.title: MidnighTreats College Park
cards.subtitle: 4513 College Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Order a plant-based cookie or oat-milk treat near campus; the company’s ordering page lists pickup through 11:45 p.m. most nights and 12:45 a.m. Fri–Sat.
cards.short_summary: Plant-based cookie shop with a late Friday and Saturday pickup window.
cards.evidence_claim: MidnighTreats’ College Park ordering page lists hours until 11:45 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 12:45 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official online ordering lists pickup through 11:45 p.m. Sun–Thu and 12:45 a.m. Fri–Sat; ordering cutoffs can vary.

cards.title: The Board and Brew
cards.subtitle: 8150 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Bring a group for food and a board-game session near campus; the business page lists service until 11 p.m. most nights and midnight on Fri–Sat.
cards.short_summary: Board-game café with Friday and Saturday hours reaching midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Board and Brew lists College Park hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: The Board and Brew — College Park
cards.access_notes: Official business page lists 11 p.m. Mon–Thu and midnight Fri–Sat; food, game, and seating availability should be checked directly.

cards.title: Maman Joon College Park
cards.subtitle: 4200 Hartwick Rd, Suite D-1, College Park
cards.notes: Use this Hartwick Road Persian-food counter for an evening meal; its College Park location page posts 11 p.m. closing every day.
cards.short_summary: Persian-food destination with daily 11 p.m. business hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Maman Joon’s College Park location page lists business hours of 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and noon–11 p.m. Sunday.
cards.source_title: Maman Joon Kitchen — College Park location
cards.access_notes: Official location listing posts daily closing at 11 p.m.; confirm availability before visiting, especially during university breaks.

cards.title: Yahentamitsi Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: University of Maryland campus, College Park
cards.notes: For a campus-based evening meal, use your eligible dining access before closing; Maryland Dining identifies Yahentamitsi as one of its three dining halls.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining hall whose official dining information describes evening service.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD Dining states that its dining halls are open from breakfast until 9 or 10 p.m. and identifies Yahentamitsi as one of the three dining halls.
cards.source_title: UMD Dining Services — Faculty & Staff Dining Plans
cards.access_notes: UMD Dining says dining halls operate until 9 or 10 p.m.; consult its current hours page or app for Yahentamitsi’s daily closing time.
